subject: Privacy evidence: cross-border safeguards & bespoke DPA appendix (TherraWell)
messages:
From: Leah Turner <leaht@therrawell.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Morales <daniel.morales@therrawell.com>, TherraWell Legal <legal@therrawell.com>
Date: 2028-10-27T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: RFI: Cross-border controls + bespoke DPA appendix for TherraWell

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the demo last week — TherraWell's procurement/legal team have a few follow-ups before we proceed to the commercial review. We're compiling a short RFI focused on cross-border data handling and need two deliverables: (1) a proposed DPA appendix (we typically work from a DPA annex that callers can redline) and (2) a compact evidence bundle that maps Redwood's controls to the EU-US Data Protection Framework (DPF) equivalence points and to our internal transfer controls.

Specific asks from Legal:
- Proposed DPA appendix that covers international transfers, subprocessors, KMS/key custody, and permitted use of model data.
- A mapping table showing which controls satisfy DPF articles and any residual gaps.
- Confirmation of data-at-rest residency options and whether we can restrict inference to EU-only hosts.
- How model routing works when a customer requests region-locking or reduced-fallthrough to hosted models.
- Audit runbook: steps you would provide for a customer audit (logs, retention, sample export).

Target timeline: can you get a first-pass DPA appendix + evidence summary within 5 business days? We're aiming to present to our CISO next Thursday. If helpful, happy to do a short call to align scope.

Thanks,
Leah Turner
Head of Compliance Programs
TherraWell Health

(Attachment: TherraWell_RFI_Outline_v1.pdf)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Turner <leaht@therrawell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-27T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Cross-border controls + bespoke DPA appendix for TherraWell

Hi Leah — thanks and great to connect.

We can absolutely produce both items within your window. Attached are two stubs I can iterate on quickly: a DPA appendix draft (labelled as an appendix so you can integrate it into your master DPA) and a short controls manifest that maps our technical/operational controls to core DPF equivalence points.

Highlights / quick answers:
- Region locking: Redwood supports EU-only inference endpoints via our Private (VPC) or Dedicated deployments. Hosted API can be routed by policy; we can pin model routing to EU-only capacity for contractual customers.
- Key custody: we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, we offer HSM integrations with customer keys for encryption-at-rest; default hosted keys remain Redwood-managed unless customer opts in.
- Subprocessors: full list attached as an exhibit; we can provide SOC 2 reports and subprocessors' security summaries on request.
- Audit runbook: we'll include an exported sample (syslog + request traces for a 30-day window), plus guidance on token-level cost/latency logs you'll likely want for forensic review.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will circulate the initial DPA appendix + mapping (attached).
2) Ben (security ops) and Kimberly (legal enablement) will review redlines and add operational evidence.
3) We schedule a 30-min call with your CISO team if any high-risk gaps appear.

Deliverables attached (v0.1):
- TherraWell_DPA_Appendix_Draft_v0.1.docx (attachment)
- Crossborder_Safeguards_Evidence_Summary_v0.1.xlsx (attachment)

If you can confirm whether you prefer a fully private deployment (Dedicated/VPC) or you want to explore hosted-with-contractual-residency options, that'll help us prioritize controls.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0128

--

Thanks — helpful. A few clarifying questions before we review the draft with our CISO:

1) For Hosted customers: can you confirm the SLA/cutover timeline if we require on-request region-locking (i.e., ability to disable fallthrough to non-EU model variants within 24 hours)?
2) Key custody: if we go with HSM partner in hosted mode, will the keys ever be stored outside EU control boundaries? We need absolute clarity for our DPF mapping.
3) Data subject rights: we need a short operational note on how Redwood handles DSARs (timing, data exports, deletion flows) when requests arrive via controller vs. processor channels.

Can you add short snippets responding to 1–3 into the DPA appendix or as a one-page memo? If not possible in time, provide the bullet answers and we'll fold them into our review.

Appreciate it — Leah

Hi Leah — thanks for the clarifying questions. I'm attaching an updated appendix and a curated evidence packet; below are the short answers we promised for your CISO.

1) Hosted region-lock SLA/cutover: For enterprise contract customers, we guarantee a policy-enforced routing change (region_lock toggle) within 24 hours of signed change request. For Dedicated/VPC customers the change can be applied in the control plane with a standard maintenance window (typically < 4 hours). We'll include the control-plane audit timestamp in the runbook export so you can validate the timeline during an audit.

2) Hosted HSM / key location: When customers elect the HSM partner path for hosted deployments we only store wrapped keys; the master key material remains in the partner HSM. For customers requiring EU-only key residency we'll enable partner HSMs with EU key-fortressing (we've validated with our HSM partners in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1). We'll add the partner attestation as part of the evidence pack.

3) DSAR handling (controller vs. processor):
- Controller-initiated DSARs: we provide a full export package (redacted as requested) within 30 calendar days; operationally we surface request traces + stored artifacts and a deletion token if required.
- Processor-assist DSARs: we provide logs and exports to our controller customers within 5 business days of authenticated request from the controller; deletion actions are executed on controller instruction and recorded in our audit log.

Deliverables attached:
- TherraWell_DPA_Appendix_v1.1.docx (updated appendix with answers to 1–3)
- DPF_Evidence_Packet_TW.zip (mapping table, SOC2 summary, partner HSM attestation, redacted request traces)
- Runbook_Audit_Export_Steps.md (step-by-step export + verification steps for auditors)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TherraWell-Compliance-Share
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/TW-DPA-Appendix/12345

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute technical handoff with Ben and our infra lead to walk through the runbook and show a sample EU-only request trace export.

Best,
Avery Johnson
